title: on the error vector magnitude as a performance metric and comparative analysis
abstract: In this paper, we present the error vector magnitude (ETM) as a figure of merit for assessing performance metrics. We show that the performance metrics are useful signals. We define EVM for a common industry standard and derive the relationships among EVM metrics for different performance metrics. We also compare among the different performance metrics and show that EVM can be equivalently useful as signal to noise ratio and bit error rate. A comparison is made between the performance metrics based on their performance of EVM based on these relationships.
